commands.notes: Only enabled once link resolution reaches playable with an RSS/audio-backed item.

backendRequests.title: Add a canonical URL intake command for LinkResolutionRequest
backendRequests.details: Contracts use existing LinkResolutionRequest/LinkResolutionResult types, but the command matrix has no importLink/importSourceLink command yet. Steward should add shared command vocabulary and runtime routing for share-sheet and paste URL intake.

backendRequests.title: Implement resolver providers for public podcast discovery links
backendRequests.details: Resolve Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and Overcast discovery URLs to open RSS feeds/audio enclosures when metadata permits. Exclusive/private links must return needs_review or unsupported without fake audio.

backendRequests.title: Expose link resolution queue state in canonical snapshots
backendRequests.details: Gate UI needs resolving, playable, needs_review, and unsupported state plus failure reason and candidate title/audio metadata. Current snapshot field matrix lacks linkResolutionStatus/queueState fields.

notes: Queue states for this track are resolving, playable, needs_review, and unsupported.
The Spotify fixture demonstrates playable resolution via open RSS audio without network provider clients.
Apple Podcasts exclusive and private Overcast examples intentionally degrade because no open RSS audio fixture is available.
No shared runtime, schema, command matrix, snapshot matrix, or validator files were changed by this gate.
